description: CommandMate #3003 (folding in Kewton/commandmate-skills#272): under `## 対象ファイル`, a backtick-quoted file name reaches `suspected_files` whatever its extension — or none. Measured: `expression.ebnf` declared there never reached scope.allow (Kewton/Musunest#212, worked around by renaming it to `.md`), nor did `Cargo.lock` / `requirements/ci.txt` (Kewton/CommandAgent#520; `Cargo.lock`, having no "/", did not even raise `unrecognized_file_extension`). FILE_EXT stays closed: it guards PROSE tokens, and under a deliverable heading there is none — the argument #219 already made for patterns. `Makefile` is the extensionless shape (`…file`). The `.ts` source still derives its L1 test companions; the others derive nothing (no rule for their extensions), which is the non-source exclusion working as before.
